items.title: RT by @charliebilello: RT by @charliebilello: 10 years ago: 30-yr mortgage rate was 3.4% & median existing home price in the US was $250k Today: 30-yr mortgage rate is 6.7% & median existing home price is $446k Result: $39k increase in down payment (assume 20% down) & 160% increase in monthly payment (from $887 to $2,302)
items.content:
10 years ago: 30-yr mortgage rate was 3.4% & median existing home price in the US was $250k

Today: 30-yr mortgage rate is 6.7% & median existing home price is $446k

Result: $39k increase in down payment (assume 20% down) & 160% increase in monthly payment (from $887 to $2,302)
